timing.cold: first actual MCP call on new session; session construction outside timer
timing.warm: same session: one discarded warmup and two measured actual MCP calls; best of two per case
timing.grouping: nearest-rank across cases for each tool
timing.index_interpretation: repeated full build, not a no-op or cached index response

material_limits: Raw failure is retained; static call graph does not identify a causal bottleneck.

execution: read-only source review; no native command
